## Not all the same

These cells come from one root tip, drawn here as they look under a microscope. Most show a round nucleus, but some look quite different. Tap the cells that look different from the rest.

<!-- STEP -->
## Why they differ

The cells of a growing root tip divide continuously, and this process is **cell division**. When the root was preserved, each cell stopped at whatever stage it had reached. So the different cells you found are different stages of division.

<!-- STEP -->
## Which stage comes first?

Tap the cell you think comes first. Then read the four stages in order. You will learn the names of these stages in higher grades.
